verdict.rationale: Rive's docs state the runtimes are open-source libraries, and the public rive-runtime GitHub repo exposes renderer and runtime code. A community comment confirms an MIT license for the rendering layer but notes it is only a subset and that the Editor, the core authoring product, is not open. missing for 10: open-source Editor/core product, first-party license documentation for the runtimes, independent confirmation that the full runtime set is under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The Rive runtimes are open-source libraries that allow you to load and control your animations in apps, games, and websites.
this is an MIT license for Rive's rendering abstraction layer, a subset of the Rive runtime that requires the Rive Editor to build content for.
Loads .riv files, advances state machines and animations, and draws via the abstract Renderer interface.
